name: Avatar
description: A user profile image component with fallback support and accessible image loading
designIntent: The Avatar component displays user profile images with a circular frame. It includes fallback content when the image fails to load or is not provided, and follows accessibility best practices for user avatars.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alt text for the avatar image (for accessibility)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the avatar container

examples.title: Avatar with image
examples.description: Avatar with image and fallback text

antiPatterns.title: Don't forget alt text
antiPatterns.code:
// Avoid: Missing alt text
<Avatar>
  <AvatarImage src="/avatar.jpg" />
</Avatar>

// Prefer: Always include alt text
<Avatar>
  <AvatarImage src="/avatar.jpg" alt="John Doe" />
</Avatar>
antiPatterns.description: Alt text is essential for accessibility. Always describe the avatar content.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use vague fallback text
antiPatterns.description: Fallback should be meaningful. Use initials or abbreviations that identify the user.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use avatars for non-people
antiPatterns.description: Avatars are designed for people. Use other components for logos or objects.

accessibility.implementation: AvatarImage requires alt text. AvatarFallback content is announced when image fails
accessibility.userRequirements: Always provide meaningful alt text for AvatarImage

accessibility.implementation: Radix Avatar handles image loading errors and displays fallback automatically
accessibility.userRequirements: Test fallback display with broken image URLs

accessibility.implementation: Avatar can be focused and has visible focus ring when keyboard navigable
accessibility.userRequirements: If avatar is interactive (clickable), ensure it has proper focus states

guidelines: Use initials from the user's name
For unknown users, use generic indicators like '?' or 'U'
Ensure high contrast with fallback background color
Describe who or what is in the avatar
Use the person's name when available
For generic avatars, describe the purpose
Don't include 'avatar' or 'image' in alt text (it's redundant)

compositionRules.relationship: Avatars are commonly used in Message components to identify the sender
compositionRules.example: Message component uses Avatar to show user or assistant identity

compositionRules.relationship: Avatars are often used in user menus or profile headers
compositionRules.example: UserMenu displays current user's avatar for quick identification
